name: Howling in the Hills

narrative.details:
adventurer, the gnolls are still out there.  I can hear their baying as they hunt in the hills above Lakeshire.  And one cry is louder than the rest - Yowler,  their leader.

Kill Yowler and send his pack scattering!  Bring me his paw as proof.

And be careful, this gnoll is their leader for a reason.  He is no Mongrel...
narrative.objectives: Bring Yowler's Paw to Verner Osgood in Lakeshire.
narrative.offerRewardText: Again, thank you for your help. The Stormwind army is so busy dealing with the orcs, they don't have the troops to protect Redridge from local threats like the gnolls.
narrative.requestItemsText: Yowler is a dangerous creature, adventurer. If you're not ready for him, I understand.
